name: invoke_authorized_bounded

test_list.description: A recursive grep must authorize each descended file before opening it and return no partial matches when any file is denied.
A denied workspace ignore file aborts before its contents can suppress or expose matching rows.
An oversized ignore file is rejected even when its filename casing differs on a case-insensitive filesystem.
A directory whose name matches an ignore filename is rejected before walker consumption.
On Unix, a FIFO whose name matches an ignore filename is rejected before a blocking open.
On Unix, a symlink whose name matches an ignore filename is rejected before target contents can be consumed.
The caller output cap intersects the registry cap and serialized results never exceed the effective bound.
The real CAS bounded-read path rejects a physically oversized corrupt blob as a read-bound error before decoding.
Corruption below the caller read bound retains the existing opaque not-found response.
A zero caller output cap is rejected before attempting to resolve or read a content reference.
A denial after earlier entries were inspected aborts the entire invocation without returning partial output.
A grant for a directory query root does not grant access to any descended entry.
Direct reads authorize the exact normalized file target without requiring ancestor-directory grants.
On Unix, reject a FIFO through pre-open metadata inspection so a blocking open cannot hang a workspace read.
Workspace-dependent builtins authorize the workspace root before resolving or reading paths.
The authorized entry point rejects P2 writes and strict input-schema violations before dispatch.
Valid JSON serialization is measured in escaped bytes and accepted exactly at the effective output cap.

inputs.name: arguments
inputs.description: JSON arguments validated against the registered builtin input shape.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Calling session, frame, workspace root, and deadline.

inputs.name: policy
inputs.description: Trusted authorization policy consulted before each workspace resource access.

output_description: A complete bounded result, or a single structured error with no partial output.
